scope_note: Low-confidence completion account for Microsoft San Antonio. Construction scenarios apply explicit 25%-75% construction-eligible shares to the reported greater-than-$840 million real-and-personal-property floor before using the Prince William County benchmark, so IT equipment is not silently treated as building construction. Operating scenarios combine the reported greater-than-75 employee floor with zero, half, or all of the separate 20-job expansion forecast; they are sensitivities, not fulfillment findings. County GDP, employment, and wage gaps are descriptive 2024 benchmark comparisons and are not facility effects. Existing source projections cover fiscal revenue, public support, and facility water demand. No annual net-fiscal estimate is made because verified same-scope recurring receipts and marginal public-service costs are unavailable.
